notes: The opening film ends more cleanly: your commander lands clear of the deck, and the reactor is now yours to find in the first mission.

Hired guards are now as tough as the commander. At a quarter health they drop out of the fight until a medic reaches them, or walk to the med bay. Levels 6 to 50 are rebuilt for the new rules, so you can keep your progress or start over.
Medics are new: hire one outside the walls near a gate and they heal fallen guards where they lie.
Guards and drones now stay within your turrets' reach, and defend levels drop enough scrap to buy everything, with bigger waves and a new star in place of the time limit.
Every danger now gets a red marker, with an arrow at the screen edge when it's off screen.
If a level can't be won any more, you can restart or keep playing. A star you can no longer earn is marked lost straight away, and if the base falls with raids still to come, the level is lost.
No more shooting prey through walls, the walkable area is now a fixed distance past your settlement, and storms can now destroy the reactor unless you help keep it fuelled.
The overflow star is gone, machines have their own upgrade pads, and pickup trays sit at the machine's edge.
